<div class="wrap">
<h1>8-K item tape</h1>
<p class="sub">Current-window Form 8-K items from the live EDGAR feed. Item 4.02 is non-reliance on prior statements. Item 3.01 is a listing notice. Item 2.02 is results of operations, not a parsed earnings beat. The feed has no ticker tag — company name and the SEC URL are shown as filed. Click a header to sort.</p>
<div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
<div class="kpis" id="items"></div>
<input id="q" placeholder="filter company or item" autocomplete="off">
<div id="board"><div class="loading">Loading /data/8k-filings.json</div></div>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> reading what issuers just told the SEC, by 8-K item, without inventing a ticker map or an earnings surprise.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/8k-filings.json (generated_at, window_days, item_labels, by_item_counts, red_flags, high_impact, filings[] with company, accession, filed_at, items, filing_url).<br>
<b>Important items:</b> 4.02 non-reliance / restatement; 4.01 auditor change; 3.01 delisting notice; 1.03 bankruptcy; 2.06 impairment; 1.05 cyber (shown when tagged); 2.02 results of operations; 5.02 officer change; 1.01 material agreement; 2.01 acquisition.<br>
<b>Not:</b> an 8-K guidance parser, an Item 2.02 beat/miss, or a ticker join. Research only.</div>
</div>
<script>
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&","<":"<",">":">",'"':"""}[c];});}
function strip(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();}
function hot(it){return it==="4.02"||it==="4.01"||it==="3.01"||it==="1.03"||it==="2.06"||it==="1.05";}
var SORT="filed_at", DIR=-1, ITEM="", PACK=null;
function val(r,k){
  if(k==="company") return r.company||"";
  if(k==="filed_at") return r.filed_at||"";
  if(k==="items") return (r.items||[]).join(",");
  if(k==="accession") return r.accession||"";
  return r[k];
}
function cmp(a,b){
  var av=val(a,SORT), bv=val(b,SORT);
  if(av==null||av==="") { if(bv==null||bv==="") return 0; return 1; }
  if(bv==null||bv==="") return -1;
  if(SORT==="filed_at") return (Date.parse(av)-Date.parse(bv))*DIR || 0;
  return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))*DIR;
}
function th(key,label){
  var arrow=SORT===key?(DIR<0?" v":" ^"):"";
  return '<th class="'+(SORT===key?"on":"")+'" data-k="'+key+'">'+label+arrow+"</th>";
}
function paint(){
  var d=PACK; if(!d) return;
  var labels=d.item_labels||{};
  var rows=(d.filings||[]).slice();
  var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
  rows=rows.filter(function(r){
    if(ITEM && !(r.items||[]).some(function(x){return x===ITEM;})) return false;
    if(!q) return true;
    var blob=(r.company||"")+" "+(r.items||[]).join(" ")+" "+(r.accession||"");
    return blob.toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;
  }).sort(cmp);
  var h="<table><thead><tr>"+th("filed_at","Filed")+th("company","Company")+th("items","Items")+th("accession","Accession")+"</tr></thead><tbody>";
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    h+="<tr><td>"+esc((r.filed_at||"").replace("T"," ").slice(0,19))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+(r.filing_url?"<a href=\""+esc(r.filing_url)+"\" target=_blank rel=noopener>"+esc(r.company||"")+"</a>":esc(r.company||""))+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+(r.items||[]).map(function(it){return '<span class="item '+(hot(it)?"hot":(it==="2.02"?"earn":""))+'">'+esc(it)+(labels[it]?" "+esc(String(labels[it]).slice(0,28)):"")+"</span>";}).join("")+"</td>";
    h+="<td>"+esc(r.accession||"")+"</td></tr>";
  });
  document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table><p class=sub>"+rows.length+" of "+(d.filings||[]).length+" filings in the "+esc(d.window_days)+"-day window. Generated "+esc(d.generated_at||"")+". Click headers to sort. Company names are as filed; no ticker was invented.</p>";
  document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]").forEach(function(el){
    el.onclick=function(){var k=el.getAttribute("data-k"); if(SORT===k)DIR=-DIR; else {SORT=k; DIR=k==="filed_at"?-1:1;} paint();};
  });
}
(async function(){
  var d=null;
  try{var r=await fetch("/data/8k-filings.json?t="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"}); if(r.ok)d=await r.json();}catch(e){}
  if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.filings)){document.getElementById("board").textContent="8k-filings.json missing or empty.";return;}
  PACK=d;
  var st=d.stats||{}, counts=d.by_item_counts||{}, labels=d.item_labels||{};
  document.getElementById("kpis").innerHTML=
    '<span class="chip"><b>'+(st.total_filings!=null?st.total_filings:d.filings.length)+"</b> filings</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+(st.red_flag_filings!=null?st.red_flag_filings:(d.red_flags||[]).length)+"</b> feed red flags</span>"
    +'<span class="chip"><b>'+(st.high_impact_filings!=null?st.high_impact_filings:(d.high_impact||[]).length)+"</b> feed high-impact</span>"
    +'<span class="chip">window '+(d.window_days!=null?d.window_days:"?")+"d</span>";
  var keys=Object.keys(counts).sort(function(a,b){return (counts[b]||0)-(counts[a]||0);});
  document.getElementById("items").innerHTML='<span class="chip on" data-item="">all items</span>'+keys.map(function(k){
    return '<span class="chip" data-item="'+esc(k)+'"><b>'+esc(k)+"</b> "+esc(String(labels[k]||"").slice(0,22))+" ("+counts[k]+")</span>";
  }).join("");
  document.getElementById("items").onclick=function(e){
    var c=e.target.closest("[data-item]"); if(!c) return;
    ITEM=c.getAttribute("data-item")||"";
    document.querySelectorAll("#items .chip").forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle("on",x===c);});
    paint();
  };
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=paint;
  paint();
})();
</script>
